title: My name is, and numbers
explanation: On arrival day you say who you are and where you go. Use I am and My name is. Use numbers for gates, terminals, and addresses. Use This is / That is to point.

sections.heading: I am / My name is
sections.text: Say My name is Harpreet. Say I am from India. At customs, this is enough. Do not say I is or My name are.

sections.heading: Numbers and addresses
sections.text: Gate B12, Terminal 1, 12 King Street. Say numbers clearly. My address is 12 King Street, Toronto.

sections.heading: This is / That is
sections.text: This is my passport (in your hand). That is the taxi line (over there). This is my form.

examples.note: This is for something near you

try_it: At customs, say: My name is ____. My address is ____.
